definition: WellFounded of strict parthood on non-null objects. This is a mereological termination policy, not causal well-foundedness and not merely simple-part existence.
note: The chapter Step1p127 explicitly invokes termination; pp129–131 defend P2 qualitatively (fn186). Standard WellFounded is the classical order rendering of that termination reading; this is not a proof that it describes reality.
